meta.title: Agent Rails — Dashboard
meta.description: Manage AI agents with secure Solana payments
common.name: Name
mode.nativeDescription: Your wallet signs every transaction directly. No vault, no limits — you are the only guardrail.
mode.agentRailsDescription: The agent pays from a vault with per-transaction, per-window, and per-session ceilings, with an on-chain receipt for every payment.
home.emptyDescription: Create your first workflow to group agents around a vault.
home.layout.hint: Drag the handle between panels to resize. Use the toolbar to swap or change orientation.
workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.description: Companies, projects, and operations with their agents
workflows.emptyDescription: A workflow groups agents around a vault.
workflowRow.noAgents: No agents in this workflow yet.
workflowRow.confirmRemove: Remove workflow "{name}" and its agents from the dashboard?
workflowRow.exportedNothing: No enabled MCP in this workflow has a command — nothing to run.
workflowRow.exportedSkipped: {count} enabled MCP(s) skipped: no command set.
workflowDialogs.createWorkflow.title: New workflow
workflowDialogs.createWorkflow.descripti: A workflow groups agents around a vault. You can create it now and connect the on-chain treasury later.
workflowDialogs.createWorkflow.treasuryH: Create one with pnpm agent-rails init and paste the address here so the dashboard reads real balance and limits.
workflowDialogs.editWorkflow.title: Edit workflow
workflowDialogs.editWorkflow.description: Name, description and icon are dashboard labels. The treasury address decides which on-chain vault this workflow reads.
workflowDialogs.editWorkflow.treasuryHin: Clear the field to detach the workflow from its on-chain treasury; the dashboard then shows no balance instead of a stale one.
workflowDialogs.createAgent.title: New agent
workflowDialogs.createAgent.description: The limit below is what the UI shows. The limit that actually applies is the on-chain policy, set by the operator within the owner's ceiling.
workflowDialogs.editAgent.title: Edit agent
workflowDialogs.editAgent.description: The daily limit here is what the UI shows. The limit that actually applies is the on-chain policy, set by the operator within the owner's ceiling.
agents.title: Agents
agents.emptyDescription: Create a workflow first, then add agents to it.
agents.footerNote: Pausing here only changes the dashboard label. Revoking the on-chain session is an operator action that requires a signature — never from the agent side.
agentSettings.general.description: Identity, daily limit, and payout wallet for this agent.
agentSettings.limits.description: Dashboard-side spend tracking. On-chain policy limits live under the workflow treasury.
agentSettings.limits.noDashboardLimit: No daily limit configured in the dashboard.
agentSettings.treasury.description: Agents spend from the workflow vault — deposits and withdrawals are treasury operations shared by all agents in this workflow.
agentSettings.treasury.connectVault: Connect a vault to this workflow
agentSettings.mcps.description: MCP servers this agent can reach (global, workflow, or agent scope).
agentSettings.mcps.empty: No MCPs apply to this agent yet.
agentSettings.skills.description: Skills injected into this agent's context when enabled.
agentSettings.skills.empty: No skills apply to this agent yet.
agentWallet.fromChain: Detected from on-chain session — save to persist in the dashboard.
treasury.title: Treasury
treasury.description: Vaults and funds for each workflow
treasury.emptyDescription: Each workflow has a vault. Create a workflow to get started.
treasury.setupHint: Deposits and withdrawals move real funds and require the owner's signature. Create the treasury via CLI and connect the address to this workflow:
treasuryDetail.title: On-chain vault
limits.title: Limits
limits.descriptionShort: Spending limits by workflow and agent
limits.descriptionLong: Loosening only flows downhill: the owner sets the ceiling, the operator defines the policy within it, the agent spends within the policy.
limits.emptyDescription: Create a workflow with agents to track limits here.
wallets.title: Wallets
wallets.descriptionLong: Wallets, vaults, and addresses organized. Balances come from the selected cluster.
wallets.emptyDescription: Connect your wallet at the top or create a workflow to see addresses here.
mcps.title: MCPs
mcps.description: Tools your agents can use. State is saved on the server.
mcps.emptyDescription: Connect MCP servers to give your agents tools.
mcps.dialog.title: Add MCP
mcps.dialog.description: MCP servers give agents tools. The Agent Rails server exposes only payment and query — never withdrawal or policy changes.
mcps.dialog.editDescription: What the runner spawns for this server, and the environment it gets.
mcps.commandHint: The executable the agent runner spawns. Leave empty and this server is skipped on export.
mcps.argsHint: One argument per line — they are passed through without shell splitting.
mcps.envHint: API keys and connection strings. Stored on the server; this page only ever sees a mask.
mcps.invalidEnvKey: Environment names take letters, digits and underscores, and cannot start with a digit.

apis.title: My APIs
apis.securityDescription: The full value is never sent back to the browser — the API only returns a mask. An Anthropic key here connects chat to your real data.
apis.emptyDescription: Without a key, chat runs in demo mode.
apis.maskNote: Even when revealed, this is the mask — the real value never leaves the server.
apis.dialog.title: Add API key
apis.dialog.description: The key is stored in ~/.agent-rails/dashboard.json with mode 600 and never returns in full to the browser.
account.title: Account
account.description: How you identify yourself in this dashboard
account.noWalletHint: Your wallet is the identity for this dashboard. Nothing here requires a password.
account.emailGoogleNotImplemented: Not implemented yet. The previous button only stored a fixed email in the browser, which gave the impression of a session that never existed — so it was removed rather than kept as decoration.
account.authFutureNote: For real authentication, the path is an identity provider (NextAuth or Privy) with a server session. Until then, the connected wallet fills that role.
profile.title: Profile
profile.avatarHint: The initial comes from the display name. Photo upload requires a file bucket, which does not exist in this project yet.
profile.bioPlaceholder: Tell us a bit about yourself…
settings.title: Settings
settings.customRpcHint: Only https and public hosts — internal network addresses are ignored and the default cluster is used instead.
settings.languageNote: Changes apply immediately across the dashboard.
settings.limitAlertsDescription: Highlights agents above 80% of their daily limit.
settings.emailNotificationsDescription: Requires an email provider — not connected yet.
settings.dataStorageNote: Everything you create here is stored in ~/.agent-rails/dashboard.json.
settings.restoreConfirm: This deletes workflows, agents, and saved keys and restores demo data. Continue?
settings.restoreWarning: Restoring deletes workflows, agents, and saved keys. It does not touch anything on-chain — vaults and sessions remain on the network.
chat.title: Chat
chat.welcome:
Hi! I'm the Agent Rails assistant. Tell me what you want to build — for example *"I want a DeFi agent system"* — and I'll explain each part.

I can read your workflows and on-chain vaults, but I never sign anything: you confirm every money movement.
chat.placeholder: What do you want to build?
chat.error.noText: The provider returned no text. This usually means an invalid key, no credits, or a usage limit.
chat.error.checkApiKey: Check your API key in **My APIs**.
chat.error.checkSubscription: This chat uses your **Claude subscription** via Claude Code. If you hit a usage limit, wait for the reset or add an Anthropic API key in **My APIs** as a fallback.
